name: Voidrp
storyline: VOID RP was born from a shared passion for role-playing games and fantasy worlds. As players ourselves, we set out to create the game we had always dreamed of: an immersive world where everyone can embody their own character, forge alliances, and write their own story. We pooled our ideas and skills to build an experience in which the players' choices shape the adventure.
summary: VoidRP is an immersive multiplayer role-playing experience set in an open world where every player can build their own story.
